disclosures.text: An AI Case Checker reviewed this draft for arithmetic, jurisdiction, and capacity consistency. The drafting itself was produced deterministically from the bound rule set and clause library — no AI authoring contributed to the will text. The checker raised one amber finding which was resolved by adviser amendment and confirmed by manager review prior to issuance.

This will was prepared on the basis of the fact-find recorded under the bound binding_chain.fact_find_id. The adviser has not been instructed on, and this will does not address, lifetime tax planning, business succession, foreign-asset disposition, or trust structuring beyond standard residuary provisions.
Fees for this matter are set out in the engagement letter dated 2026-05-20 and were accepted at instruction.

Complaints about this advice may be raised first with the firm's Complaints Officer and, if unresolved within eight weeks, escalated to the Legal Ombudsman (or, where the matter is SRA-regulated, to the Solicitors Regulation Authority).
Personal data collected for this matter is processed under UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) (contract) and Art. 6(1)(c) (legal obligation). Retention follows the firm's published retention schedule.
